page.overview:
What is Aquasharks?

Their vehicles were a mixture of black and blue, with some red. The transparent parts tended to be neon orange. They never had a permanent base but the biggest set was 6190 Shark's Crystal Cave.

The Aquasharks were villainous underwater miners who competed with the Aquanauts for control of crystals and crystal mines. A comic in the 1996 UK catalog shows that the Aquasharks are afraid of an octopus nicknamed "Pus".
